question: Who was given the title of 'Hanjaba' by the Maharaj of Manipur for reviving Manipuri dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bipin Singh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bipin Singh**:-

 
 
• He was given the **title of 'Hanjaba'** by the** Maharaj of Manipur** for reviving Manipuri dance.
 
• Bipin Singh was a **renowned dancer, choreographer, and teacher** of Manipuri dance, who played a crucial role in reviving and popularizing the traditional dance form.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Charu Malhar:-**

 
 
• He** **was also a** well-known dancer and choreographer.**
 
• She is known for her contributions to **Kathak dance.**
 
 
 
• **Darshana Jhaveri:-**
 
 
• **She **is a **contemporary dancer and choreographer**, who has worked extensively in the field of Indian classical and modern dance forms.
 
 
 
• **Kalavati Devi:-**
 
 
• She​ was a renowned **Manipuri dancer and teacher**, who was instrumental in promoting the dance form in India and abroad.
